brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of free area and clear any obstruction before the forecast heat event as outlined in SOP-015. Additionally, apply the ambient de-rating prescribed in MG-021 if the 24-hour average ambient exceeds 30 degrees, recording every de-rating applied, its reason, value, and period. Note that the supplied documents do not provide specific guidance for ONAN cooling type adjustments beyond ambient and sustained event rules.
